title: OPMOD
description: QoL Fabric Mod for the german OPSUCHT Server Network.
body:
## 🥇 OPMOD _Enhance your experience on Germany’s biggest Citybuild server: OPSUCHT_
### Configure OPMOD with `/opmod` We highly recommend going through the settings to discover what OPMOD is truly capable of!
New features and settings are added regularly, so don't forget to check them out and optimize your gameplay. But if you don't want to, that's perfectly fine. OPMOD's default settings are carefully chosen to provide a great experience right out of the box.
## Our Features
📊 Trading - Auction, Market & Shard price/value in tooltips - even `/sw abc` prices are included - Shard widget for daily rates - _...and other small features_
🧑‍🌾 Farming - Job Tracker Widget - Custom RTP Menu - RTP Cooldown Widget - Better AFK Warning for Jobs
🏠 Citybuild - Auto Fly - Minion Notifications & more
🎒 Inventory - Buttons with useful command hotkeys - Show information about your inventory - "Inventory full" warning - _...and other small features_
👁️ Visuals - Custom Inspect Animation for all "Bohrer" types - Rainbow effect on high level enchants - Hide Custom Model Items in different ways - _...and other small features_
🛡️ Protection _Never place or write anything you don’t want_ - Offhand Blocker - Sign Protection - Rename Protection - Link Protection
And additionally: - "k", "m" and "b" support for /pay and most anvil inputs - `/signsearch ` - Search for text on signs! | `/signsearch` without any input to reset your search
Take a look!: [Ingame Screenshots](https://modrinth.com/mod/opmod/gallery)
